correctness.rationale: Coefficient lifting lemma follows continuous variation of r_j>0 with Σr_j=1: Σ|a_j|²/r_j ranges from (Σ|a_j|)^2<=1 to infinity for >=2 nonzero terms; singleton and zero cases use orthogonal spare coordinate. For normal commuting F, C*(I,F(s)) is abelian, F has norm-continuous compact spectrum of common profiles K via uniform finite-net argument. Any x,y give a Riesz complex measure of TV<=1 and mass q. Conversely finite Borel partitions approximate ν uniformly; faithful functional calculus makes disjoint nonzero approximately-eigenprofile subspaces, and lifting gives compatible unit x,y; singleton K reduces to scalar F. Weak* compact measure slice has norm-compact image by finite ε-partitions. Compact convex minimax over TV ball gives sup Reλ = inf_z[Re(qz)+max_f|λ(f)-z|]; coercive for |q|<1, including q=0 minimum circle. Finite checker samples are not a proof of uniform closure/minimax. No gap found.
